evidence: The MV-0401-PRO is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Customizable multiview layout and arbitrary scaling adjustments, with real-time layout changes and live scaling display. For LED output compatibility, it supports LED screen resolutions up to 8 million pixels, including standard 4K output as well as custom resolutions such as 8K×1K and 1K×8K for special LED display scenarios.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The MV-0401-PRO is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Customizable multiview layout and arbitrary scaling adjustments, with real-time layout changes and live scaling display. For LED output compatibility, it supports LED screen resolutions up to 8 million pixels, including standard 4K output as well as custom resolutions such as 8K×1K and 1K×8K for special LED display scenarios.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

The MV-0401-PRO is specifically designed to fit perfectly inside the NHD-000-RACK4, making it easy to be part of a NetworkHD system. Slot the switcher next other encoders and decoders for a tidy and convenient installation.
